corporate governance systems are effective when they are designed to be responsive to the context of the country in which the firm is operating.

corporate governance and board of director characteristics are significant predictors of firm performance in emerging markets, and that the impact of these characteristics varies depending on the context of the emerging market.

1) the context of the emerging stock markets influences the relationship between board characteristics and firm performance; and 2) the context of emerging stock markets influences board characteristics.

the influence of context on organizational governance, the role of the board of directors, and the influence of context and organizational governance on firm performance in emerging markets.
the influence of context on the relationship between board characteristics and firm performance in emerging markets, and the role of the board in corporate governance.
the role of the board of directors in emerging markets.

corporate governance and board of director practices in emerging markets are not as effective as they should be.
the board of directors in emerging markets should have more members than the board of directors of a company in developed markets.
the board of directors is an integral part of the corporate governance system and the board’s role and effectiveness is influenced by the context of the emerging market.

context is important in corporate governance and that the board of directors and organizational governance are important in corporate governance.

the board of directors and the corporate governance system of an emerging market firm can be a powerful tool for the company to manage the unique business, economic, political and social challenges of the country in which it operates.
the board of directors and organizational governance are significant factors in the context of corporate governance.

the board of directors and corporate governance systems in emerging markets should be designed to be more flexible and responsive to local context than their counterparts in advanced economies.
context matters in emerging stock markets and that context is important for corporate governance theory development.
